prompts.formed: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one original square seamless game PBR BASECOLOR texture scan, not a scene. Orthographic front-on continuous TWO METRE SQUARE of dense grey highway concrete filling every pixel. Photographic cement paste, fine pores and sparse stone fines with restrained contrast, calm large fields. Perfectly even cross-polarized diffuse illumination: no directional light, shadows, ambient-occlusion gradients, highlights, reflections, perspective, vignette or border. Seamless all four edges with even statistical distribution. Do not include actual structural joints, expansion gaps, bolts, hardware, rebar, road markings, text, edge bevels, objects, or a dark lower/base band. Structure and placement wear will be separate in the engine. Opaque square image, ideally 2048 by 2048. Finish: restrained unpainted shutter-formed concrete for a bridge deck fascia and traffic barrier. Neutral medium-light cement grey, approximate unlit sRGB #9b9b94. Very faint horizontal softwood formwork imprint: fine, shallow elongated grain traces and a few low-contrast board impressions integrated into cement, about 15-25 cm per board, without black grooves. Occasional tiny shallow pore/chip. This must read as smooth dense concrete with evidence of casting, not wooden planks, masonry, broken plaster or all-over noisy gravel. Keep most forming traces subtle and interrupted.
